Description: Chews on a wooden building, damaging it and refilling its own food. Hungry wild alphabeavers do this to your buildings on their own.
Runs at a target and blows itself up with its normal death explosion.
Sprays burning fuel in a small radius around itself. Requires Biotech.
Trunk blast: water spray that knocks back, staggers and puts out fires. Trunk throw: picks up a nearby chunk and hurls it.
Targets another hare, puts both of their abilities on cooldown, and creates another hare.
Effect not decided yet: make enemies flee, a debuff, or a stink gas cloud.
Fast dash along the ground to a nearby spot.
Turns invisible (the same invisibility as Royalty's psycast) until it attacks. Movie reference: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon.
Dashes along the ground at a target, battering and knocking back enemies where it lands.
Rapidly heals its injuries for a short time; cast automatically when badly hurt. Marvel reference.
